heard: Columbia's 28th mission revealed a deadly flaw. It was the world's first shuttle to reach space. Just 82 seconds after liftoff, a foam piece struck. This impact punched a hole in the wing's armor. Superheated gases melted the wing's internal structure during reentry. Columbia disintegrated at 15 times the speed of sound. All seven crew members were lost in the breakup. Investigators found NASA could have launched a rescue using Atlantis. Amazingly, a canister of live roundworms survived the fall. These survivors were the legacy of that 28th mission.
